name: Nonomura Yuuto
source: The protagonist who lives alone after the death of his father and the abandonment by his mother and [spoiler][url=/c36911]older sister[/url][/spoiler]. While he had gotten used to it, this time he suddenly felt very lonely due to the recent passing of grandmother, the sole close relative he had left.
